preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 0 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n and ui != vi for ui, vi, ti in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ti <= 10**18 for ui, vi, ti in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge weight ti must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 10^18.

postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of all interesting triples' s values modulo 10^9 + 7.
